ED726.title: Economics Education
modules: Qualities Of A Good And Effective
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most complicated evaluation instrument at the disposal of the teacher."
Essay test is the most complicated evaluation instrument at the disposal of the teacher.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the location, selection, and recruitment of capable personnel to do what is needed to be done in a school in terms of instruction and other supporting activities."
Staffing is the location, selection, and recruitment of capable personnel to do what is needed to be done in a school in terms of instruction and other supporting activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a curriculum guide used by schools for specifying which subject to be taught."
Syllabus is a curriculum guide used by schools for specifying which subject to be taught.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a plan of activities to be carried out in a class during the course of a day, a week or a term, nothing more and nothing less."
The lesson plan is a plan of activities to be carried out in a class during the course of a day, a week or a term, nothing more and nothing less.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with human behaviour such as how people earn their living and make a choice between alternatives to satisfy their wants."
Economics is concerned with human behaviour such as how people earn their living and make a choice between alternatives to satisfy their wants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a lesson plan for duration of a term or a year."
The long term plan is a lesson plan for duration of a term or a year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any learning activity carried out by a group of learners outside the classroom under a close supervision of the teacher."
Field trip is any learning activity carried out by a group of learners outside the classroom under a close supervision of the teacher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the channel through which educational institutions translate societal aspirations with concrete reality."
The curriculum is the channel through which educational institutions translate societal aspirations with concrete reality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an activity presented during a lesson to show a specific issues or situation for study and discussion."
Role-playing is an activity presented during a lesson to show a specific issues or situation for study and discussion.
fib: ______ is a leader because of his administrative responsibilities in the school.
school principal
The school principal is a leader because of his administrative responsibilities in the school.
______ refers to planning for a specific topic to be taught in a lesson /lessons for a day or spaced over a number of days or one or two weeks for example the daily or weekly lesson note b.
short term plan

The short term plan refers to planning for a specific topic to be taught in a lesson /lessons for a day or spaced over a number of days or one or two weeks for example the daily or weekly lesson note b.
______ is concerned with the totality of the knowledge to be imparted in a lesson i.e. the content d.
teacher
The teacher is concerned with the totality of the knowledge to be imparted in a lesson i.e. the content d.
______ is responsible for designing an educational instrument for the selection and recruitment of students, and staff as the case may be.
Economics teacher
Economics teacher is responsible for designing an educational instrument for the selection and recruitment of students, and staff as the case may be.
______ is a continuous process in teaching-learning process.
Evaluation
Evaluation is a continuous process in teaching-learning process.
______ is the continuous assessment component of the course.
TMA
TMA is the continuous assessment component of the course.
______ is a plan or a guide; it is not as detailed as the notes we give to students.
lesson note
A lesson note is a plan or a guide; it is not as detailed as the notes we give to students.
______ is an interactive process involving the teacher and the student or among the student themselves.
Discussion
Discussion is an interactive process involving the teacher and the student or among the student themselves.
______ is a pre-requisite for good citizenship.
understanding of economics
The understanding of economics is a pre-requisite for good citizenship.
